'''Soach's Organization''' was a criminal group operating in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. Led by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Qual'om Soach]], the organization was involved in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], [[Black market/Legends|black marketeering]],<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> and [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
